MS-OPS-002: SELECT session_id,command,status,percent_complete,estimated_completion_time AS remaining_ms,total_elapsed_time AS elapsed_ms FROM sys.dm_exec_requests WHERE session_id=:session_id AND command IN ('KILLED/ROLLBACK','ROLLBACK');
OR-MON-037:
SELECT owner, table_name, column_id, column_name, data_type,
       data_length, char_length, char_used, data_precision, data_scale,
       nullable, identity_column, virtual_column, data_default
FROM all_tab_cols
WHERE owner = :owner_user AND table_name = :table_name
ORDER BY column_id;
